title: Protocol to infer off-target effects of drugs on cellular signaling using interactome-based deep learning.
authors: Meimetis, Nikolaos; Lauffenburger, Douglas A; Nilsson, Avlant
one_liner_zh: 该文用神经网络建模药物转录响应并推断脱靶效应，虽涉及转录因子FOXM1但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Drugs that target specific proteins often have off-target effects. We present a protocol using artificial neural networks to model cellular transcriptional responses to drugs, aiming to understand their mechanisms of action. We detail steps for predicting transcriptional activities, inferring drug-target interactions, and explaining the off-target mechanism of action. As a case study, we analyze the off-target effects of lestaurtinib on FOXM1 in the A375 cell line. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Meimetis et al.(1).
abstract_zh: 靶向特定蛋白质的药物常伴有脱靶效应。我们提出了一种利用人工神经网络模拟细胞对药物转录反应的协议，旨在理解其作用机制。我们详细描述了预测转录活性、推断药物-靶点相互作用以及解释脱靶作用机制的步骤。作为案例研究，我们分析了lestauritinib在A375细胞系中对FOXM1的脱靶效应。关于此协议的使用与执行的完整细节，请参阅Meimetis等人(1)的文献。
